zones.name: Loch Modan
zones.summary: Dwarf and Gnome second zone: Thelsamar hub, the Loch shore and Stonewrought Dam, Algaz, Farstrider Lodge, Ironband’s Excavation, and the Mo’grosh stronghold. Leads on to the Wetlands.

zones.name: Teldrassil
zones.summary: Night Elf starting zone: Shadowglen, Dolanaar hub, Starbreeze Village, Lake Al’Ameth, the Oracle Glade, Gnarlpine Hold, and the Rut’theran crossing to Darkshore.

zones.name: Darkshore
zones.summary: Night Elf second zone: Auberdine hub, the northern coast and Twilight Vale, the Ruins of Mathystra, Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran, the Tower of Althalaxx, the long southern coast to the Master's Glaive, and the beached-creature series. Leads on to Ashenvale in the south.

quests.name: The Family and the Fishing Pole
It's All Fun and Games Until...

zones.name: Stormwind City
zones.summary: The first city guide: the Alliance capital as a repeat-visit hub — districts, class and profession lines, the Defias and Diplomat chains, the Stockade, the Onyxia and epic-mount endgames, and accept-based expeditions to 20+ zones.

quests.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

zones.name: Ironforge
zones.summary: The second city guide: the dwarven capital as a repeat-visit hub — districts, class and profession lines, the Uldaman and Gnomeregan chains, the Magni endgame and dungeon-tier set, and accept-based expeditions to 20+ zones.

zones.name: Darnassus
zones.summary: The third city guide: the night elf capital as a repeat-visit hub — the Temple of the Moon, the Cenarion Enclave and the trades terraces, the druid class chain flagged for the future Set 4 druid guide, the Moonglade link, and accept-based expeditions to 15+ zones.

zones.name: Redridge Mountains
zones.summary: Set 2 opener: Lakeshire hub, the gnoll and orc lines, the Rethban and Alther’s Mill chains, the messenger exits to Stormwind, Westfall and Duskwood, and the western oddities. Leads on to Duskwood and the Burning Steppes.

zones.name: Ashenvale
zones.summary: Set 2 second zone (Alliance): Astranaar hub, the Tower of Althalaxx chain, Raene’s Cleansing, the Foulweald and Xavian lines, the Stonetalon exits, and the western oddities. Leads on to Stonetalon and the Barrens.

zones.name: Stonetalon Mountains
zones.summary: Set 2 third zone (Alliance): Stonetalon Peak hub, the Gaxim/Kaela and Gerenzo chains, Windshear Covert Ops, the Charred Vale, the south-camp Desolace-border finales, and the custom object chain. Leads on to Desolace and the Barrens.

zones.name: Duskwood
zones.summary: Set 2 finale (Alliance): Darkshire hub with Night Watch, Stalvan, Sven, Abercrombie, Viktori and Carevin chains, Raven Hill, the custom Nightmare mission board, writs and twins. Leads on to Stranglethorn and Redridge.

zones.name: Wetlands
zones.summary: Set 3 opener (Alliance): Menethil Harbor hub with the Halloran, Boran barrel, Third Fleet, Lightforge, Dragonmaw and Diplomat chains, the digsite and Dun Modr south, Rethiel east, the Shaman water chain, Villard far south and Kixxle writs. Leads on to Arathi, Dustwallow and the city expedition legs.

quests.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
In Search of The Excavation Team
Craftsman's Writ: Draught of Water Breathing

zones.name: Stranglethorn Vale
zones.summary: Set 3 (Alliance): two-pass route - northern jungle (Nesingwary camp, Rebel Camp, Kurzen compound, east jungle) then Booty Bay and the cape; expedition legs to Badlands, Swamp of Sorrows, Arathi, Tanaris, Hillsbrad, Duskwood, Dustwallow, Alterac, Thousand Needles, Hinterlands and Riverglades. Leads on to the next Set 3 zone.

quests.name: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

zones.name: Riverglades
zones.summary: Set 3 (Alliance route in a shared Forever-original zone): Farholde command, the western Twilight front, the central farms, Powderfuse Port and the northern ogres; expedition legs to Stormwind, Tanaris and Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: If a Tree Falls, and No One Hears...

zones.name: Thousand Needles
zones.summary: Set 3 (Alliance-accessible route in a contested zone): Whitereach, the Mirage Raceway chains, the Shimmering Flats pilots, the mage line and the Geomancy scroll; expedition legs to Ratchet, Booty Bay, Badlands, Dustwallow, Gadgetzan, Undercity and STV Hemet.

zones.name: Desolace
zones.summary: Set 3 closer (Alliance route in a contested zone): Nijel's Point, the Magram and Gelkis clan chains, the kodo country, the coast and the mage line; expedition legs to Maraudon, the Swamp of Sorrows, Booty Bay and Stormwind.

quests.name: A New Need for Shadow Protection

zones.name: Hillsbrad Foothills
zones.summary: Set 4 opener (Alliance route in a contested zone): Southshore hub, the Syndicate north, the murloc coast, the Dibbs scholar chain and the seasonal pair; expedition legs to Ironforge, Stormwind, the Wetlands, Arathi, Silverpine, Alterac and Booty Bay.

zones.name: Arathi Highlands
zones.summary: Set 4 second zone (Alliance route in a contested zone): Refuge Pointe hub, Stromgarde streets, the Myzrael binding stones, the Faldir's Cove seafarer chain, the Shaman and Mage class lines; expedition legs to the Wetlands, Hillsbrad, Ironforge, Stormwind, Stranglethorn, Desolace, Razorfen Kraul and Ravenholdt.

zones.name: Alterac Mountains
zones.summary: Set 4 second zone (Alliance route in a contested zone): the mountain crossing between Hillsbrad and the Plaguelands, the Syndicate documents that clear the Hillsbrad 512/514 debt, the Ansirem and Modera chains, the warrior Cyclonian line, rogue Ravenholdt follow-ups, high finales to 46, and optional writ turn-ins.
